captions.detailed: A flat wall-panel air purifier featuring a thin, light-gray rectangular mounting board meant to sit flush against a wall. A rectangular main housing body is mounted to the board, finished in a matching light gray. A dark-gray front-access filter panel is attached to the left vertical edge of the housing, swinging on a revolute hinge. Inside the housing, a prismatic filter cartridge can slide out on guide rails.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a flat wall-panel air purifier. It should feature a large, thin rectangular backplate, a central rectangular housing body, and a dark front filter panel that swings open on a revolute joint along its left edge.
captions.factory: The code constructs three main parts: a wall backplate, a central housing body, and a front filter panel. The backplate is created as a thin Box primitive. The housing body is a slightly thicker, smaller Box centered on the backplate. The front filter panel is modeled as a thin, dark-colored Box. An articulation of type 'revolute' is defined on the left edge of the housing to swing the front filter panel open.
